title: MAINTENANCE: unix_secs_to_rfc3339 duplicated in contact, chat, message
description:
/crates/kith-store/src/contact.rs:172
/crates/kith-store/src/chat.rs:196
/crates/kith-store/src/message.rs:38

Three independent implementations of unix_secs_to_rfc3339 (same algorithm, different comment styles).
Risk: Divergence if one is patched and others are not. Test vectors are module-local and won't catch cross-module bugs.

Solution: Extract to shared fn in lib.rs and re-export to contact, chat, message modules.
Impact: Reduces test maintenance burden and ensures all consumers use identical implementation.
